name: Real Estate Live Transfers

hero.headline: Real Estate Live Transfers
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for real estate solutions.

overview: Real Estate Live Transfers are consumers qualified by our team and warm-transferred to your agents, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Deliver buyer, seller and investor leads and calls to real estate brokerages, agents and home-buying companies.

Live Transfers deliver real estate teams appointment-ready conversations. Our team confirms the transaction type, property location and ownership, approximate value, timeline, representation status and consent before warm-transferring to the agent or acquisition team. This pre-screen removes consumers outside the market area, those already under contract with an agent and long-horizon browsers, so agents spend their time with sellers and buyers who are ready to move. Transfers complement web leads by dramatically improving contact rates, which are a persistent weakness of form-based real estate leads, and by getting motivated sellers on the phone before competing agents reach them.

This product is suited to web leads businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of real estate consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Homeowners considering a sale, prospective buyers preparing to enter the market and property owners seeking a cash offer, spanning all price tiers with concentration in owner-occupied single-family homes. The most valuable segments are sellers planning to list within the next few months, motivated sellers facing relocation, inheritance or financial pressure, and pre-approved buyers actively touring homes.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: searching for what is my home worth, sell my house fast or real estate agents near me; relocating for work or a life change within a defined timeframe; inherited a property or managing an estate sale; facing foreclosure, divorce or financial hardship requiring a sale.
howGenerated: Consumers are acquired through performance campaigns targeting searches such as "what is my home worth" and "sell my house fast", plus social and comparison placements. Interested consumers speak with our qualification team before any transfer is attempted.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard real estate criteria include: transaction type identified as buying, selling, or requesting a cash offer; property or target area located within the agent's or company's market; for sellers, ownership of the property confirmed and approximate value stated; timeline for transacting within the buyer's target window; not currently under contract with another agent or company; consent to be contacted captured and interest in a consultation or offer confirmed.
delivery: Once qualified, the consumer is bridged directly to your designated number or queue with a warm introduction. Delivery runs only during your operating hours with daily caps, and you can pause or adjust criteria at any time.

faq.q: Can real estate leads be separated into buyers, sellers and cash-offer requests?
faq.a: Yes. Transaction type is captured on every lead, and programs can be dedicated to seller leads, buyer leads or motivated seller cash-offer requests according to your business model.

faq.q: How precisely can market areas be targeted?
faq.a: Targeting can be set by metro, county or ZIP code so that leads and transfers come from the markets where your agents or acquisition team operate.

faq.q: How do calls complement real estate web leads?
faq.a: Web leads such as home valuation requests build pipeline at scale, while Inbound Calls and Live Transfers connect motivated sellers and buyers directly with your team, raising appointment and listing rates.
